files.html:
0.2.6 Change Log

Requires DRM Core 0.2.8 or later.

  • Improved overall UI layout and usability.
  • Fixed various GUI issues.
  • Fixed NPC hiding behavior after battles.
  • Hidden NPCs are now visible while holding the DRM Core item.
  • Resetting the battle count now also unhides the NPC.
  • Fixed NPC detection, pursuit, and dash behavior before battles.
  • Fixed Pokémon NPC animation and preview issues in basic settings.
